messages:
incidence-bot: :rotating_light: Paging: elevated tail latency detected in egress routing (p99 CPU-bound spikes) affecting streaming sessions in eu-west-2. Automated SLO alert fired: p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Triage channel created. Join bridge: https://call.example/bridge123

alice: I'm on it. seeing p95 ~ 350ms, p99 ~ 1.5s. Streaming stalls reported (consumer ack lag growing).

ben: logs show uneven routing distribution to shard group eg-12; one router host at 98% CPU. likely hotpartitioning after yesterday's weight seed change.

carol: any recent routing policy rollouts? I saw a rollout job from infra around 02:10 UTC that changed egress affinity for a subset of customers.

dan: @carol yes rollout 02:10 bumped prefer_local affinity eval flag -> weight delta on region-bound shards. I have the rollout ID: rollout-2026-03-15-0210.

elaine: Customer-impact check: CS dashboard shows 14 customers with >5% error/latency regressions in last 10m; highest impact on streaming webhook consumers.

alice: copying relevant metrics: 
```
metric:router.request.latency.p99 = 1500ms (eu-west-2)
metric:stream.ack.lag = +320ms
hot_shard: eg-12-03 -> 78% of routed requests
```

ben: reproducing locally against router config, looks like hashing policy sends many keys to same backend when region affinity is enabled and fallback range is narrow. bug: weight normalization didn't account for zero-capacity backends.

carol: mitigation plan: 1) rollback the rollout (rollout-2026-03-15-0210) 2) temporarily relax prefer_local weights 3) enable eager fallback to cross-region pools for streaming sessions.

alice: executing rollback now. patching rollout -> `infra rollback rollout-2026-03-15-0210 --force`

incidence-bot: rollback job started by alice at 3891234570. job id job-555.

dan: while rollback runs, set a quick WAG (workaround) to clip per-shard max weight to avoid hotpartition. applying config: `router.cfg.max_shard_weight=0.2`

ben: clip applied, router group eg-12 weight capped.

elaine: early signal: p99 dropping to ~900ms after weight cap, streaming ack lag down to +120ms. customers reporting fewer stalls.

carol: rollback complete at 3891234595. rollout reverted. need to monitor for 15m.

alice: I'm still seeing one host with elevated CPU (98%) but requests are draining. kicking a graceful drain on host eg-router-03: `systemctl stop router && kill -SIGTERM $(cat /var/run/router.pid)` then drain flows.

ben: router eg-router-03 drained and removed from pool at 3891234603. new routing distribution looks even. p95~320ms p99~420ms.

product-ops: alerting affected customers: CS sent initial blurb and ETA for follow-up. no customer-facing outage declared yet; we're classifying as degraded.

elaine: tally: ~0.6% of total traffic impacted at peak, ~14 customers saw elevated latencies, no persistent data loss.

alice: closing the live mitigation loop. next steps: postmortem, patch to weight normalization, add canary gate when affinity changes are applied, and a runbook tweak to auto-cap shard weight on rollout.

dan: filing a hotfix PR referencing job-555 and the rollout id. PR: https://git.example/r/infra/rollouts/pulls/789

ben: also adding a short-term telemetry check to detect >50% routing skew to any shard and auto-trigger weight clip.

carol: assigning owners for postmortem: ben (root cause & fix), alice (mitigation timeline), dan (rollout tooling), ela ine (customer impact notes).

alice: handing off to next on-call @sre-rotations at 3891234628. I'll post a short summary in #postmortems and link the bridge logs. :thumbsup:

sre-rotations: taking over. thumbs on the runbook and will keep watch for 1h. :eyes:

incidence-bot: incident thread closed (mitigation succeeded). follow-up: create postmortem ticket and schedule RCA within 48h.
